mapper.select: SELECT a.follow_user_id FROM tb_follow_edge a JOIN tb_follow_edge b ON a.follow_user_id=b.follow_user_id WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND b.user_id=#{otherUserId} LIMIT 100
SELECT id,user_id FROM tb_follow_edge WHERE follow_user_id=#{authorId} AND id>#{cursorId} AND created_at<=#{publishedAt} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
